subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the grouped action revisions, especially the Codex, token, registry-login, and security-scanning actions, be accepted as one security-reviewed update?
rationale: These revisions change executable third-party code in secret-bearing and security-enforcement jobs, and repository policy requires explicit handling of the protected `security` label plus direct Codex contract inspection.

options.title: Approve after source audit
options.body: Confirm the upstream commit/tag provenance, inspect the exact Codex runtime contract, and merge the grouped update after exact-head checks complete.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate Codex, token, registry, and security-scanner updates from routine setup and labeling actions to narrow review and rollback scope.

options.title: Pause the grouped bump
options.body: Leave the PR open or close it in favor of individually reviewed dependency updates if the combined security surface is too broad.

recommendation.title: Approve after source audit
recommendation.body: Confirm the upstream commit/tag provenance, inspect the exact Codex runtime contract, and merge the grouped update after exact-head checks complete.
